reviews.text: Excellent experience. I brought my dog ​​with a serious problem and found them professional, kind, and competent.
Dr. De Vivo, in addition to being a true professional, also demonstrates a great human side, excellent experience.
Great professionalism...

I don't know why the website states that the clinic also offers a 24-hour emergency room. After a veterinary visit at another clinic, I was advised to take my cat to the clinic immediately for hospitalization because he was jaundiced and had a fever of 104°F (40°C), and was near death. You can imagine that I was quite shocked by such news. Well, I called this clinic at 5:48 PM (I've attached a screenshot), so not even outside the hours indicated on the website. I received a (I think
) answer from the receptionist who rudely said, "I don't understand anything you're saying" (I repeat, I had just received news that my cat was near death). I explained the situation to her, and she replied, "We're closing tomorrow morning." Luckily, another clinic took me in promptly, even letting me stay past opening hours. But I was quite shocked and I am grateful that I did not bring my cat to this clinic, because if the empathy they show is the same as the one the secretary showed me on the phone, I don't know what would have happened to my cat.

Good and kind doctors, except for the manager, who is fakely kind. She hides her rude manners behind a false and polite Piedmontese attitude. Excessive prices. After the services, the manager always invites you to leave as soon as possible, justifying herself by saying she has to lock the door and that she can't come and go. At this point I say with the money she earns, install an intercom, with an electric opening from the inside, what the hell.

Excellent experience. We brought our 15-year-old "old man" Pochio, who had been vomiting and refusing to eat for a few days. After undergoing various therapies, tests, ultrasounds, and various check-ups, Pochio has shown signs of a clear and steady recovery. We thank Dr. Francesco, the doctors, nurses, and all the staff. In three words: professional, competent, and helpful. Thank you!

I highly recommend this clinic to all tourists visiting Naples. My Norwegian Forest Cat (with whom I travel) swallowed a swimsuit string, and the receptionist immediately put us through to Dr. Patrizia Luisé. Since he was eating well and defecating properly, she made a diagnosis remotely, emphasizing that expensive tests weren't necessary, just observation. She could have taken advantage of our tourist status to charge us for unnecessary consultations, blood tests, and ultrasounds, but she prioritized our pet's well-being. Impeccable ethics! Thank you, dear doctor, you are a true animal lover ❤️❤️❤️ P.S. In the last photo, my baby is watching pigeons through the window in Naples (even he's enjoying it ❤️
A veterinary clinic that doesn't accept emergency patients at 6pm is worth 0. Change your profession.

We were warmly welcomed, even without an appointment.
The staff is friendly and professional.
Holy people. They saved my 7-year-old Chihuahua dog with bad pancreatitis.
Arrived on Sunday morning at 8.40am and found it closed, disappointing, not to mention 24 hours a day.
Don't trust a doctor who claims to be an avian vet but doesn't understand anything about birds.
Helpful, kind and professional, thank you very much 🙏 …
A 5-star clinic with honors, whose veterinarians are prepared, courteous, helpful, attentive and animal lovers, the emergency room works very well.

If you really have no other option, go on a Sunday: you'll find Dr. De Vivo, the only "humane" person there, and after that, the rest will just try to get as much money out of you as possible to get nowhere! Thanks to them, my young cat died of a brain tumor. They turned her inside out, with tests and even a "phantom" surgery because they should have seen it! They're carrying it on their conscience, and in any case, they're no different from many other clinics that have figured out how to profit from the skin of animals! BEWARE!!!!!!

Terrible experience. They charged me €250, and I'm still waiting for the tests to be emailed back (which I've already paid for). Zero empathy. They think they're the best, but in the end they sent me home when the dog was actually in full respiratory distress. Miraculously, he's alive now, in another clinic.

Doctor and Doctor, top notch! Arriving on a Sunday morning, finding them available and attentive to our Anakin (by the way, the Doc knew Star Wars... 😍) with acute gastroenteritis, treating him with the best care, with indescribable kindness—in short, we couldn't have met better people.

Thank you, thank you, and thank you again!
(Emanuele, Morena, and Anakin - 11/24/2024)
Great experience
Very humane and good doctors

I'm so glad I Googled you and brought my asthmatic and uncooperative kitten. We arrived at the emergency room in the evening, where they welcomed us with such kindness and professionalism, immediately understanding the situation. Our kitten needed oxygen and a cortisone injection. The next day we brought him back for a bronchial x-ray and blood tests. Today my kitten is doing much better, and slowly, with the right care you've given us, we're regaining the serenity we'd lost for a long time. Thank you so much, and see you soon from Macchia ❤️

Unfortunately, my experience at the Cavour Veterinary Clinic was disappointing in several respects. The facility appears unkempt, poorly maintained, and the lighting is truly terrible, immediately conveying a sense of neglect and discomfort. A healthcare environment, especially a veterinary one, should inspire order, cleanliness, and professionalism: here, the opposite occurs.
Interaction with the veterinarian was even more problematic. Her attitude was extremely cynical and dismissive, with cold, unsympathetic communication lacking the minimal attention one expects when entrusting an animal to a professional. There is a lack of listening, clear explanations, and sensitivity, essential elements in this type of work.
Overall, the clinic leaves a negative impression, both structurally and humanely. Significant improvements are needed, especially in terms of the welcoming atmosphere and the relationship with clients and their animals.
I've been calling for several minutes and now the line is out of order

Really poor communication. They don't respond to emails, they are difficult to phone. I finally got an appointment but had to wait ages because it is just chaos there. They also didn't have the deworming medicine that I needed for my dog, and the aggressively abrupt reception woman was beyond rude to all clients during my visit (never to be repeated).

I thank Dr. De Vivo and the staff present on Sunday for the great help and expertise they showed our little cat. Tests and treatment were performed promptly, and she returned home, playful and fever-free. They took away our anxiety and worry with humanity and simplicity.
Again, a heartfelt thank you. Anyone in need, like me, I highly recommend the Cavour Clinic with the utmost confidence.

Trust the team of Dr. Francescone. Dr. Francescone and his colleague who accompanies him on all shifts are two highly competent veterinarians who bring humanity. I am the father of little Zaira. I went to the Cavour clinic, which is historic, but I mean historic. A taxi driver who took me to the clinic didn't want money. So we're talking about humane people. Because the taxi driver, by not wanting money, means he took me not to a clinic, but to a place where my dog ​​can be treated properly. I recommend the clinic to all those who call animals their furry friends.
My Zaira has had surgery. My compliments go to everyone, Dr. Luisè, for the trust she placed in saving my little one.

I've brought all my puppies to this clinic since I was 18, I'm almost 49 now, and I wouldn't change it for anything in the world! They're incredibly professional, reliable, and what I love most...their profound realism in dealing with the situation! These are TRUE professionals who have a true and sincere love for animals!
They are exceptional doctors!!!!
Excellent clinic, humane and professional staff, not venal like other places. They treated my Siamese with love.
I didn't know this clinic, I went there two days ago for a problem with my dog, I must say that the doctor was incredibly empathetic, very very good. If I remember correctly, it's Dr. Voccia

We had our puppy Maradona admitted to the hospital on Monday night. We met so many angels who immediately took Maradona to heart and cared for him. A special thanks goes to Dr. Testa, a kind soul who, even though the puppy's condition was serious, gave us a small glimmer of light. Since Friday, Maradona has been home with us again. Thank you so much. You are angels on earth. I recommend this clinic also because a few years ago I also had my dachshund admitted and it was always a great experience. Here is your puppy.
Experience, professionalism, sensitivity, and humanity are the fundamental traits of all the clinic's staff. They are a fundamental point of reference for anyone who owns a pet.
A clinic that works very well there is Dr. Valeria and Dr. Francesco of an unheard of humanity they treated Bianchina with all their soul I will never stop saying Thank you 😘💗 …
100% reliable

This evening we brought our dog with a high fever. Two doctors with rare empathy, both towards the dogs and towards us owners. They performed a very thorough and meticulous examination. Compared to other facilities offering the same service that charge a lot for little, they are not at all mercenary.

Yesterday I went to the clinic and brought my American Bully. Not only are they true professionals, they are kind and empathetic. They helped and treated my dog, who the day before in another well-known clinic was given up for dead from gastroenteritis. I will never thank the staff at the Cavour clinic enough for helping my dog, who obviously didn't die as others had told me... thank you, thank you and thank you again.

I would like to thank the Doctor and the Doctor who took care of my little girl yesterday, Sunday 16/02/2025, even though she didn't make it last night. I wanted to thank them for the humanity and love they had towards her and for the great sensitivity they had towards us.
Good clinic, we were there for our Romeo, finally treated by good vets, I recommend this clinic☺️
I took my cat to the vet for a problem caused by my previous vet, and I must say that with a lot of patience and love, they were able to help me. I highly recommend them.

Excellent and very empathetic doctors...
Greetings to Dr. SOFO... THANK YOU
High professionalism and great availability

I had a kitten examined. The wait was a bit long despite a reservation. Qualified staff, clean environment.
I'll definitely be back.

24-hour emergency room?
False, closed on the evening of September 26th.
YOU ARE THE SHAME....OPEN 24 HOURS A DAY....TODAY FRIDAY 23 AUGUST, I'M ON HOLIDAY....THEY REOPEN ON MONDAY...AN EMERGENCY ROOM....I WISH YOU THE SAME PAIN I FELT TODAY

I've known them for years and they're always very professional. You always feel like you're dealing with knowledgeable and serious people. I recommend them to anyone who owns and loves a pet. Since the lockdown, it's advisable to call first for emergency care.
